## 👋 Welcome!

My name is **Jiahao Tian** (Tommy). I am a third-year undergraduate student at the [School of Mathematical Sciences](http://www.math.zju.edu.cn), **Zhejiang University (ZJU)**, majoring in Statistics.

I am passionate about exploring the intersection of rigorous mathematical theory and stochastic data. My research journey is currently focused on Statistical Inference and its diverse applications.

---

## 🔍 Research Interests

* **Core:** Statistical Inference, Causal Inference, Machine Learning, Biostatistics.
* **Extended:** Bayesian Statistics, Stochastic Analysis, Quantitative Finance.

---

## 🛰️ Research Experience

### **Knockoff Method & FDR Control**
* **Advisor:** [Prof. Lijun Wang](https://hohoweiya.xyz/), School of Mathematical Sciences, ZJU.
* Currently conducting research on statistical inference, specifically focusing on the **Knockoff method** for controlling the False Discovery Rate (FDR). 
* Active member of the weekly lab meetings (Thursdays) discussing recent research progress and the *Elements of Statistical Learning (ESL)*.

### **Multimodal Learning & Causal Inference (SRTP)**
* **Advisor:** [Prof. Xiaoye Miao](https://person.zju.edu.cn/miaoxy_cn) (via PhD Mentor), ZJU.
* Working on an SRTP project focused on **Multimodal Learning**, Causal Inference, and **Missing Data Imputation**. 

---
